messages:
Maya (Design): quick sketch: persistent invoice hotspot next to scope selector + a compact vertical token pill in rows. figma link in thread.
Eric (PM): finance wants download obvious. hotspot OK if keyboard + mobile are covered.
Sam (FE): implementable. collapse left rail to icon+label under 980px. ensure tab order: scope -> hotspot -> filters.
Lina (Eng): perf: virtualize rows; only stick the hotspot container to avoid reflows.
Olivia (Content): CTA copy: "Download invoice (PDF/CSV)". aria-label: "Download billing invoice for selected scope and period".
a11y-bot: Reminder: hotspot must be reachable within two tab stops of scope toggle and have aria-describedby for tooltip. use aria-pressed for scope toggle.
Maya (Design): mobile variant: full-width invoice button in header. desktop: small icon+label in hotspot.
Eric (PM): sprint acceptance: invoice within two tab stops, mobile header CTA, ARIA labels present. compact/dense preference deferred to settings next sprint.
Sam (FE): I will draft component props: TokenPill({compact:true}), HotspotAction, and keyboard flow doc.
Lina (Eng): I will add virtualization plan and propose show_fiat query flag for lazy fiat.
Olivia (Content): I will finalise strings and localization keys.
Maya (Design): will update figma and add aria notes. added to tomorrow's design review agenda.
